concerns.text: The proxy baseline used to normalize Computational Cost (FR-008) is derived from the median of the same cohort of studies that are later included in the primary meta‑analysis (FR-006). This makes the baseline non‑independent of the outcome data, creating a circular normalization step that can bias effect‑size estimates and invalidate hypothesis‑testing assumptions. The specification should require an external or pre‑specified baseline, or treat proxy‑normalized records as a separate analysis branch excluded from the primary effect‑size computation.
